text.zh: 简单对比可以采用不超过三列、每格简短的 Markdown 表格；内容较长或移动端需要横向滚动时改用分级列表。邮件和纯文本中的复杂数据提供 CSV 供表格软件读取。HTML 使用原生表格，PPT 使用可编辑原生表格或清晰截图，并在目标设备检查完整可读性。用户显式指定载体时遵循其要求。
text.en: A simple comparison may use a Markdown table of at most three columns with short cells; when the content is long or mobile would need horizontal scrolling, use a hierarchical list instead. For complex data in email and plain text, provide a CSV that spreadsheet software can read. HTML uses native tables, and PPT uses editable native tables or clear screenshots, checked for full readability on the target device. When the user explicitly specifies the medium, follow it.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

trigger.zh: 需要用表格呈现对比或数据时
trigger.en: When a comparison or data needs to be presented as a table

purpose.zh: 用简短表格辅助比较，同时保证目标设备上可读
purpose.en: Aid comparison with short tables while keeping them readable on the target device

exclude.zh: 内容较长或移动端需要横向滚动的表格（改用分级列表）；用户显式指定载体的情形
exclude.en: Tables with long content or that would need horizontal scrolling on mobile (use a hierarchical list); when the user explicitly specifies the medium
